purpose: Cheapen AnalysisEngine::resolve deferred-receiver lookup on the official two-project warm complete index. Do not skip project-file body inference or restore the August 1 resolve cache-hit fast path.

cut.why: CPU-weighted samply of AnalysisEngine::resolve put proven_deferred_receiver_type at 0.927s inclusive, of which exact_expression_type was 0.886s. type_at(Expression) scanned every type fact in the file; local-read fallback scanned every read in the file. facts_by_file is already sorted by (start_byte, end_byte) after replace_file.
changes: type_at(Expression) and facts_for(Expression) binary-search the sorted file bucket for the exact range.
Named type_at keeps the reaching-assignment scan. Expression identity is the range, not a start_byte prefix.
TypeStore::add may unsort the file bucket; those lookups stay linear when file_owned_indexes_ordered is false.
exact_expression_type local-read fallback uses binary_search_by_key on the file-owned sorted read index.
not_done: Do not restore the August 1 resolve cache-hit fast path (semantic complete regressed 7–16%).
Do not iterate all file type facts for TypeSubject::Expression on the production replace_file path.
Do not skip TypeTracker / higher-order / local flow / inferred returns on project files.
Remaining exclusive resolve is still ~1.85s. Re-flame before the next micro-cut.
